title: ANY.RUN describes five Thanksgiving and Black Friday phishing and malware campaigns seen in 2026
date_note: Publication day of the ANY.RUN blog post; the campaigns it describes were observed between September and November 2026.
place: ANY.RUN (location not stated in the source)
geo_basis: no place stated in the source
summary: ANY.RUN's blog post describes five holiday-themed campaigns it observed: a fake Thanksgiving invitation leading to a Google Workspace login page, an e-card that downloads a ScreenConnect installer, a fake MyChart survey collecting personal data, a Black Friday newsletter hiding an NDA phishing link, and a Word coupon with an embedded VBS script. ANY.RUN says the script's download failed in all observed tasks.
plain: Security firm ANY.RUN lists five holiday-themed scams and malware lures it saw this autumn, from fake logins to a fake coupon document.
exec: ANY.RUN reports holiday-themed lures aimed at employees and shoppers, including a credential-theft page and a remote-access installer.

validation.note: Only the ANY.RUN post itself was read.
